summary:
Round 7 of T7 at HEAD 2753871. HEAD equals origin/task/T7 and the worktree is clean. Against base b4523aa, the diff touches only the thin-shell files (3 deleted D4/D7 helpers, build_geometry_grid.m deleted, evaluate_design_point.m, run.m and solve.m modified) and adds two new tests. There are no renames and no shared file was edited out of turn.

The behaviour is correct, and every number I reproduced matches:
- Suite: 26 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped, 723.8 s, EXIT 0. test_thin_shell_stage3 passed in 531.2 s.
- Independent closed-form re-derivation in Python (cylinder prisms):
  - case 1: t = 0.0355691 m, z_ballast = -2.8034629 m, rho_eff [1758.34 353.857 353.857 608.947] kg/m^3;
  - case 3: GM residual -0.638748 at t_min, z_ballast -2.741502 m;
  - case 6: curve end t = 0.8904143 m;
  - the design's GM at (vs 0.5, t 0.04) is -0.22027.
  All agree with the code's output.
- My own draft-free test, which has a known exact optimum, passes (see own_test).
- The round-7 knot double's Boehm insertion is exact: a Python port changes the surface by at most 4.4e-16 at degrees 1, 2 and 3.
- I reran test_thin_shell_stage3 with T5's real F10 (check_against_stage2.m from /home/user/wt/T5) placed ahead of the stand-ins. It passes, so T7 does not rely on the GM row entering pass (decision a).

Two minor quality findings remain. Neither is fixed or listed as deferred, so the round is not accepted (procedure step 5):
1. Round 7 added misindented blocks to the test (lines 148, 222-224, 243-245).
2. solve.m defines a local ternary (lines 498-504) that duplicates the existing mwecmass.internal.ternary.

Both fixes are mechanical and change no number.

Status of each acceptance item:
- Plan "C1 thin-shell run under the Octave shim": moved to the J2 head by contract section 6 and the brief. Not checked here.
- Realised densities reported next to the floors: met. The report prints rho_eff, rho_floor (NaN until T4b) and rho_stage2 in one row.
- No D2/D4/D6/D7/D17 reference on the thin-shell path: met. test_thin_shell_deletions passes and my grep of the thin-shell files is empty. The remaining references are in files other tasks own, all listed.
- Precast path does not call thin-shell functions: not met yet. modular_precast/build_geometry_grid.m:92 and modular_precast/evaluate_design_point.m:9 still call them. Decision (e) makes this a J2 item.

Deferred items d1, d2, d3 and d6 are restated with line numbers that match the files: WEC_User_Input.m 43-46 and 53-56; build_config.m 275, 277-278, 306-309; test 33-35 and 187-188.

Independent Python closed form, case 1: Stage-2 strip Z_CG -1.7041695356 m, GM2 0.3916695356 m; Stage-3 root t 0.035569099072 m, z_ballast -2.803462948506 m, rho_eff [1758.339 353.857 353.857 608.947] kg/m^3. Code: t 0.035569, z_ballast -2.803463, the same rho_eff

t_max = d_close - eps_fit/2 = 1.5 - 0.000127 = 1.499873 m, printed by solve

Escalation: fixed_draft keeps vs (cases 1-3, 5, 6); the draft is released only when rho_w V_sub lies outside [M(t_min, z_min), M(t_min, z_max)], here [9803.8, 212057.5] kg (case 4 and the own test, both 4347.2 kg)

Closest fail: case 3 and case 5 keep flotation (residuals 2.22e-7 and -2.66e-7, within tol_eq 1e-6). Cases 7 and 8 return the corner designs, with flotation residuals 0.353125648499286 and -0.349593495934959, equal to the closed forms within 2e-15

I1 closure: per-module closure holds within 4 eps in every case and in the edge and below-z_lo checks. Module-volume sum minus the closed-form hull is -3.55e-15 m^3 or 0. Module-1 V_ballast and V_air below z_lo match the closed forms to 0 and 0.60 eps
Knot restart: 0 restart lines without the double and 1 with it; the restart leaves the design unchanged (differences in t, z_ballast and vs are all 0)
Boehm insertion in the knot double, ported to Python with an independent Cox-de Boor NURBS evaluator: max |S_new - S_old| = 4.44e-16 for u-degree 1, 2 and 3

Decision (a): test_thin_shell_stage3 passes with T5's real check_against_stage2.m ahead of the stand-ins (REALF10 PROBE PASS, EXIT 0). The case-3 reason comes from the real F10 and names the GM metric

F14: run.m stores results.stage3 = S8 and final_props = props + stage3_status and stage3_check. It calls plot_steel_solve(realised, config) and export_stage3(realised, output_dir('thin_shell')) for every status (the test doubles record 2 calls in each of the 8 cases). results.Final3D is unchanged
S8 field set matches T6's precast packaging (solve_and_extract.m:166-170), and the solver fields match RESULT_SCHEMA.md in T5 (step, exitflag, iterations, fval, max_eq_violation)

D17, D4 and D7 are gone from the thin-shell path: grepping thin_shell/*.m for 0.95, 0.9, probe, t_min_active and rmin finds nothing; the forbidden-pattern grep on the changed files finds only the test's steel_t_init (deferred d3) and the fixture's closed-form pi*R^2
Deferred line numbers checked: WEC_User_Input.m 43 (t_init 0.02), 44 (t_min 0.025), 45-46 and 55-56 (D6), 53-54 (UHPC t_init); build_config.m 275 (steel_t_init), 277-278 (D6), 306-309 (prints)
own_test:
My test is /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-MWEC-Mass/4eed5a18-bc85-5f1a-b911-b09cefd00ef6/scratchpad/grader/T7/r7/grader_t7_r7_own.m (log own.log in the same folder). It tests the draft-free branch against a known exact optimum.

Setup:
- Stage 2 = the kernel properties (sti_realised) of the stable thin-shell design D: vs 0.3, t 0.03, z_ballast -2.81210183545914 floating D (flotation residual -5.4e-15). D's GM is 0.3346 m in both Python and the code.
- The Stage-2 vertical shift handed to Stage 3 is 2.4. There rho_w V_sub = 4347.2 kg, below the lightest buildable mass of 9803.8 kg, so the draft must be released.
- The objective is 0 only at D: T_heave fixes M and hence vs, then GM = GM2 and Z_CG fix t and z_ballast. So the exact answer is D.

Result: escalation draft_free, status accepted.
- vs 0.2999991863 (error -8.1e-7 m), t 0.0300000187 (error 1.9e-8 m), z_ballast -2.8121018343 (error 1.1e-9 m).
- Flotation residual 3.4e-13, GM residual -2.0e-13, fval 1.17e-13.
- Relative deviations [3.2e-7, 2.0e-13, 1.3e-7, 1.3e-8].
- OWN TEST PASS.

A first variant at vs 0.5, t 0.04 had a negative Stage-2 GM (-0.22027 in Python and in the code), so T_pitch was Inf and the objective NaN. That design was ill-posed (Stage 2 enforces GM >= gm_min > 0), not a code defect, and I dropped it.

Two more checks, described under verified:
- Python closed-form re-derivation of cases 1, 3 and 6 (scratch indep.py);
- Python verification of the Boehm insertion (scratch boehm_py.py).

required_fixes.issue: Round 7 added misindented code. Line 148 (the fprintf of the module-volume sum) is indented 8 spaces at the 4-space loop level. In cases 7 and 8 the 'check(...)' inside 'if standin' is not indented, and its 'end' sits at the case level (8 spaces), so the 'end' reads as closing the case. This is a readability defect in the closed-form guard that round 7 introduced.
required_fixes.fix: Indent line 148 to 4 spaces. Indent the check lines inside 'if standin' at 223 and 244 to 16 spaces, and their 'end' lines (224, 245) to 12 spaces, matching the 'if' at 222 and 243.
required_fixes.verify: `sed -n '145,152p;219,246p' tests/realise/test_thin_shell_stage3.m` shows each 'if standin ... end' block aligned. TESTS_FILTER=thin_shell octave --no-gui --quiet tests/run_tests.m still passes with the same printed numbers.

required_fixes.issue: The local function 'ternary' (lines 498-504) duplicates the existing helper src/+mwecmass/+internal/ternary.m, which Report.m and T6's precast solve already use. This is redundant code.
required_fixes.fix: Replace the call at line 111 with mwecmass.internal.ternary(reachable, 'reachable, draft fixed', 'unreachable, draft released') and delete the local function at lines 498-504.
required_fixes.verify: `grep -n 'function s = ternary' src/+mwecmass/+realise/+thin_shell/solve.m` prints nothing. Rerunning the suite gives 26 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped, and the 'Mass at the Stage-2 draft ... -> reachable, draft fixed' lines are unchanged.

spec_issues: Plan T7 acceptance 'C1 thin-shell run under the Octave shim' conflicts with the brief ('no whole-pipeline run'). Contract section 6 moves the C1 runs to the J2 head, so this item is not judged in this round.

Plan T7 acceptance 'the modular-precast path does not call thin-shell functions' cannot be met by T7, because the callers (modular_precast/build_geometry_grid.m:92 calls the now-deleted thin_shell.inner_properties_at_z, and modular_precast/evaluate_design_point.m:9 calls thin_shell.integrate_split) are T5/T6 files. Decision (e) makes it a J2 item. Until T5 lands, the precast path at the T7 head calls a deleted function.

S8 solver.iterations has no single meaning. T7 stores the number of design evaluations of the step (including its draft-free fmincon step), while fmincon steps elsewhere store output.iterations. RESULT_SCHEMA.md (T5) gives no definition; the schema owner should fix one meaning at J2.

The SK stand-in F10 (tests/standins/+mwecmass/+realise/check_against_stage2.m:28) still lets the GM equality enter pass, contrary to decision (a). T7's tests do not depend on it: they pass with T5's real F10.
